mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.customer_id, c.customer_name, n.follow_id, n.note_type, n.title, n.summary, n.objection_top3, n.next_topic, n.created_by, u.nickname AS created_by_name, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM crm_note n LEFT JOIN crm_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.created_by = u.id WHERE n.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT n.id, n.customer_id, c.customer_name, n.follow_id, n.note_type, n.title, n.summary, n.objection_top3, n.next_topic, n.created_by, u.nickname AS created_by_name, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM crm_note n LEFT JOIN crm_customer c ON n.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.created_by = u.id WHERE n.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
